_note: Recommendation templates for the oil and gas segment (C10, C3). Qualitative, conditional decision moves for the S&OP and component procurement planner, one block per scenario archetype in scenario_archetypes.json. No quantities, no order points, no order dates, no digits in move texts. Triggers name signal themes; engine/recommend.py maps each theme to real signal ids in the current world by matching card fields. Every threshold and every number of days below is an ASSUMPTION. The planner decides.
label: ASSUMPTION

confidence_rules.label: ASSUMPTION
confidence_rules.note: [ASSUMPTION: confidence comes from the probability margin between the leading scenario and the runner-up and from the normalised entropy across the four shown scenarios. High needs a clear margin and low entropy; low is the default. Thresholds are untested and meant to be tuned with ABB.]

defaults.label: ASSUMPTION
defaults.note: [ASSUMPTION: next action is due in two weeks unless the archetype says otherwise; revisit with the monthly S&OP cycle.]
